conflict: Someone changed this a moment ago. It was reloaded; try again.
no_currency: Set the institution's country and currency in Settings before taking fees.

counter.title: Fee counter
counter.text: Find a student, see what they owe and take the money.
counter.search_hint: Type at least two letters or digits.
counter.none: No student found. Check the spelling or try the student ID.
counter.no_bills: Nothing is owed now. Money taken waits as an advance for the next bill.
counter.amount_invalid: Enter an amount above zero, like 1500 or ১৫০০.
counter.reference_hint: Bank slip or mobile money transaction number.
counter.blocked: Bill {bill} is paid in full only. Take at least what it owes.

student.cancel_text: Nothing more is owed on it. Money already paid on it waits as the student's advance.
student.end_text: Bills made after the last day do not get it. Bills already made keep it.

discount.title: Give a discount
discount.text: Bills made while it runs take it off. Above the institution's limit someone else approves it.
discount.head: Fee head
discount.percent_invalid: Enter a percent between 0 and 100, like 25 or 12.5.
discount.pending: Discount saved. It waits for someone else to approve it.

refund.title: Pay advance back
refund.text: The student holds {amount} as an advance. Someone else approves paying it back.
refund.asked: Refund asked. It waits for approval.

receipt.title: Money receipt
receipt.void_pending: Voiding this receipt waits for approval.
receipt.computer_made: Made by computer; no signature needed.
receipt.void_text: What it paid becomes owed again. Another person approves it (if the institution asks for that).
receipt.void_asked: Void asked. It waits for approval.

takings.title: Takings
takings.text: Money taken, by how and by whom, to close the counter.
takings.none: No money taken on these days.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.text: Discounts, receipt voids and refunds waiting for someone other than who asked.
approvals.reject_reason: Why (the person who asked sees it)
approvals.own: You asked or took the money: someone else decides.
approvals.cannot: You may see these, not decide them.
